method.name: Masked Prior-Guided Candidate Reranking
method.description: Executor-side test-time adaptation: proposes primitive and skill-action candidates, verifies them against current-page feasibility evidence, and reranks the shortlist. Introduces no new skills.

reasons.SR: Paper Table 3 reports this comparison by condition only; it prints no per-website breakdown. The value is null rather than recomputed, because recomputing it would need the per-task results, which this project does not publish.
reasons.AS: Paper Table 3 reports SR and ASC only. Reported as null rather than carried over from Table 1, whose numbers come from a different model pool.
